Quotes from the Universe

Hey there, cosmic detectives! 🔍 Today, I’m diving into the brilliant world of Far Sector, the thrilling comic book series by N.K. Jemisin. You may know Jemisin for her groundbreaking novels like The Broken Earth Trilogy, or the Great Cities Series with The City we Became and the world we make but did you know she also wrote a Green Lantern comic? That’s right! Far Sector follows Jo Mullein, a Green Lantern tasked with keeping peace in the City Enduring—a metropolis on the edge of the universe where emotions have been suppressed for centuries.

At the beginning of each issue, Jemisin included a thought-provoking quote, aren’t they great ?

  1. “A man who makes trouble for others is also making it for himself.” - Chinua Achebe

  2. “Grab the broom of anger and drive off the beast of fear.” -Zora Neale Hurston

  3. “Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced” -James Baldwin

  4. “I ain’t about to be nonviolent, honey.” -Nina Simone

  5. “The master’s tools will never dismantle the master’s house.” -Audre Lorde

  6. “Do not fear mistakes. There are none.” -Miles Davis

  7. “You might win some, but you just lost one.” -Lauryn Hill

  8. “bullshit is the glue that binds us as a nation.” -George Carlin

  9. “Why don’t you guys do something?!” -Storme DeLarverie

  10. “A riot is a spontaneous outburst. A war is subject to advance planning.” -Richard Nixon

  11. “In order to rise From its own ashes A phoenix First Must Burn.” -Octavia Butler

  12. “I am no longer accepting the things I cannot change… I am changing the things I cannot accept.” -Angela Davis

The City We Became

Auteur : N. K. Jemisin

In The City We Became by N.K. Jemisin, New York City comes alive as five human avatars, each representing a borough, must unite to protect the city from a malevolent force. Blending urban fantasy with sharp social commentary, Jemisin explores themes of identity, community, and resistance in this unique take on the power of cities.

  • Winner of the 2021 Locus Award for Best Fantasy Novel

N. K. Jemisin’s website : https://nkjemisin.com
